mentions.name: Fringe Flypost
mentions.description: This PWA is a companion app for the Edinburgh Fringe Festival that builds the full catalog of shows as a SQLite database synced to the user's phone, so they can filter, search, sort, and build a schedule even with spotty data during the fest. It also adds coordination features for planning the Fringe with friends.
mentions.problem: The official Fringe app falls short and festival show data is traditionally spotty during the fest.
mentions.audience: People attending the Edinburgh Fringe Festival who want to browse the show catalog and plan their schedule with friends.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been putting together a much better app than the official one. It builds the full catalog of shows as a sqlite database and syncs it to your phone so that you can filter, search, sort, and build a schedule even with the traditionally spotty data during the fest. I also added a bunch of coordination features for planning your Fringe with friends.

It's a PWA, not a native app over at https://fringeflypost.com/

mentions.name: Fringe Flypost
mentions.description: An offline-first event tracker for the Edinburgh Festival Fringe with maps, search and filtering, scheduling, and sharing with friends. It syncs a locally stored SQLite database and caches assets aggressively so it works despite spotty connectivity at the festival.
mentions.problem: The official Fringe app is poor and connectivity is very spotty during the festival because the city is swarmed with more people than usual and older buildings kill the signal.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I've been working on https://fringeflypost.com/, an event tracker with maps, search and filter, scheduling, and sharing with friends that's offline first. It syncs down a locally stored sqlite database and caches assets pretty aggressively.

evidence.value: So I've been working on https://fringeflypost.com/, an event tracker with maps, search and filter, scheduling, and sharing with friends that's offline first. It syncs down a locally stored sqlite database and caches assets pretty aggressively.
